cards.title: Say weekend
sections: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue. Follow the stress mark in the word model. Keep unstressed parts lighter.
Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 143 - Pronunciation & Listening - 01

articulation.label: weekend
articulation.alt: weekend: /w/ → /i/ → /k/ → /ɛ/ → /n/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
